title: More room on every player screen
summary: A healthy shared room now shows as a small pill in the header, and Home lists what happened while you were away.
items: When the room is connected and everything is saved, the status card becomes a "● Live" pill in the header (or your turn); select it to open Campaign.
The full status card comes back as soon as the connection drops or changes need attention.
On phones, the scenery above each screen is a thin strip, so content starts higher.
Player Home has a "Since you were away" card: unread messages, treasure-pool items waiting for your claim, the DM's answers to your requests and journeys, and updated quests.
